title: Expansion of a Lepidopteran Carboxylesterase Gene Cluster Drives Xanthotoxin Detoxification in Spodoptera litura.
authors: Huang, Xiaodan; Li, Jun; Xiao, Tianxiang; Xu, Xiyue; Jiang, Yingjie; Yang, Zhiming; Sun, Zhongxiang; Lu, Kai
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究斜纹夜蛾羧酸酯酶基因簇扩增介导黄毒素解毒，涉及转录因子CncC/MafK调控COE表达，但核心是代谢解毒而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，且方法以实验为主，仅含分子对接，与课题AI/物理模拟方法匹配度低。
abstract: In plant-insect coevolution, xanthotoxin serves as a widespread phytochemical defense against herbivores. This study aims to elucidate xanthotoxin detoxification mechanisms in the polyphagous pest Spodoptera litura. Genomic analyses revealed an expanded carboxylesterase (COE) cluster on chromosome 2, exhibiting xanthotoxin-inducible expression in detoxification tissues. Knockdown of ten COEs significantly increased larval sensitivity to xanthotoxin, while molecular docking confirmed stable xanthotoxin-COE binding. Heterologous expression of four COEs in Escherichia coli conferred bacterial tolerance to xanthotoxin, with three isoforms demonstrating direct metabolic clearance of xanthotoxin in vitro. Mechanistic exploration identified the transcription factors CncC and MafK as critical regulators in modulating larval xanthotoxin tolerance through the coordinated activation of COE expression. Functional validation via dual-luciferase reporter assays established direct transcriptional regulation of three COE promoters through CncC/Maf binding element interactions. Our findings systematically decode both enzymatic detoxification and upstream regulatory networks, revealing how lepidopteran pests adapt to plant chemical defenses through COE pathway specialization.
abstract_zh: 在植物-昆虫协同进化中，黄原毒素（xanthotoxin）作为一种广泛存在的植物化学防御物质，用于抵御植食性昆虫。本研究旨在阐明多食性害虫斜纹夜蛾（Spodoptera litura）对黄原毒素的解毒机制。基因组分析揭示，2号染色体上存在一个扩展的羧酸酯酶（carboxylesterase, COE）基因簇，其在解毒组织中表现出黄原毒素诱导性表达。敲低十个COE基因显著增加了幼虫对黄原毒素的敏感性，而分子对接证实了黄原毒素与COE的稳定结合。在大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）中异源表达四个COE基因赋予细菌对黄原毒素的耐受性，其中三种异构体在体外表现出对黄原毒素的直接代谢清除能力。机制探索鉴定出转录因子CncC和MafK是调节幼虫黄原毒素耐受性的关键调控因子，通过协同激活COE表达发挥作用。双荧光素酶报告基因实验的功能验证确立了CncC/Maf结合元件相互作用对三个COE启动子的直接转录调控。我们的研究结果系统解码了酶促解毒及上游调控网络，揭示了鳞翅目害虫如何通过COE途径特化适应植物化学防御。
